name: crono-regatas
description: Cronometraje de regatas: PWA en GitHub Pages y app Android (Capacitor)

scripts.android:sync: npm run build:android-web && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradle.js assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradle.js assembleRelease bundleRelease
